units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>נסב</he> … <he>והוה מַכֵּישׁ להון</he> … <he>מִתְכַּשִּׁין</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מכתשין</he>) Abraham took a knocker and tried to frighten them away by knocking, but they minded it not; Yalk. ib. 77 <he>והוה מכיש להון ולא הוו מתכתשין</he>.…

senses.gloss: to be frightened off by knocking, v. supra.
